journeys.summary:
I created one article, "br-test: author controls check", at /article/br-test--author-controls-check. Its detail page showed the author-only "Edit Article" link and "Delete Article" button, each in two places on the page. The Edit link opens /editor/br-test--author-controls-check.

The system reported PUT /api/articles/:p and DELETE /api/articles/:p as blocked writes. I did not click Publish in the edit form or click Delete Article myself. The blocked entries appeared on their own as I loaded the article page and the edit page.

Not reached: the comment delete controls (span.mod-options and i.ion-trash-a) and DELETE /api/articles/:p/comments/:p. Those only render on a comment the current user wrote. Posting comments is blocked, so I couldn't create one. I didn't check whether the seeded articles already have comments by this test user, but they are other users' content, so the controls shouldn't show there.
